title: Cheesy Frankfurter and Cajun Chicken Pasta Bake
description: Short pasta baked in tomato sauce with soft onions, Cajun-spiced chicken, browned frankfurter coins and tangy gherkins, under a blanket of bubbling cheese. A hearty store-cupboard bake with a gentle kick.

items.note: or plain breasts plus 2 tsp Cajun seasoning

prep.text: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Have ready a baking dish of about 2 litres, roughly 20 x 30cm.
Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says, so it stays firm in the oven.
steps.tip: Save a mug of the cooking water before draining.

steps.text: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the chicken until golden and cooked through, with no pink in the middle. Lift it out onto a plate.
Turn the heat down to medium, add the onion to the same pan and cook until soft and lightly golden.
Add the frankfurter coins and fry, stirring now and then, until browned at the edges.
Pour in the pasta sauce, return the chicken to the pan, stir in most of the gherkins and simmer until bubbling and hot through.
Drain the pasta and stir it into the sauce with a splash of the cooking water, so it stays saucy in the oven. Season with pepper and stir in a third of the cheese.
Tip everything into the baking dish, spread it level and scatter over the rest of the cheese.
Bake until the cheese is melted, golden and bubbling at the edges.
Leave to stand for a few minutes, then serve topped with the spring onions and the remaining gherkins.

tips: Frankfurters are already cooked, so you only need to brown them for flavour.
Cajun seasoning varies in heat. For children, use a mild one or season only half the chicken.
For an extra-crispy top, finish the bake under a hot grill for 2–3 minutes.

substitutions.note: slice and brown in the same way
add a pinch of salt, sugar and dried herbs

storage: Keeps for 2 days in the fridge. Reheat covered with foil at 180°C for 20 minutes, or in the microwave with a splash of water.
